quotes.text: Somebody at the label told me to 'clean up my image.' I said, 'Sweetheart, this IS the cleaned-up version. You should've seen Thursday.'

quotes.context: Rolling Stone Magazine interview conducted in San Francisco, published in the February 7, 1970 issue — one of her last major print interviews
quotes.fake_note: I made this one up — Joplin's brash, self-mythologising humour and her adversarial relationship with industry gatekeepers are real, so pushing back on an image note fits her perfectly. quotes.text: The rider said no brown M&Ms and three cases of Moët. They got the M&Ms right. I've been punishing audiences for that Moët situation ever since and I feel no guilt whatsoever.
